study_name.evidence_quote: The Kailuan study is a prospective cohort study focusing on the Kailuan community in Tangshan
study_name.section: Methods — Study cohort and patient characteristics

subject_id.notes: Individual subject identifiers not provided in the paper

sample_id.notes: Individual sample identifiers not provided in the paper

target_condition.evidence_quote: Hypertension is one of the most prevalent cardiovascular diseases worldwide

control.evidence_quote: 41 healthy controls, 56 subjects with pre-hypertension, 99 individuals with primary hypertension
control.notes: Subgroups inferred from study design: healthy controls are control arm, pre-hypertension and primary hypertension are case arms

country.evidence_quote: Tangshan, a large modern city in northern China

body_site.evidence_quote: Stool samples freshly collected from each participant
body_site.section: Methods — Stool sample collection and DNA extraction

location.evidence_quote: Tangshan, a large modern city in northern China

antibiotics_exclusion_period.evidence_quote: Individuals were also excluded if they had received antibiotics or probiotics within the last 8 weeks

dna_extraction_kit.evidence_quote: Bacterial DNA was extracted at Novogene Bioinformatics Technology Co., Ltd using TIANGEN kit
dna_extraction_kit.section: Methods — Stool sample collection and DNA extraction

sequencing_platform.evidence_quote: All samples were paired-end sequenced on the Illumina platform
sequencing_platform.section: Methods — Metagenomic sequencing and gene catalogue construction

age.notes: Age reported only for animal experiments (8-10 weeks for mice); no participant ages reported

ancestry.notes: Study population is from Kailuan community in China; ancestry details not explicitly stated

sex.notes: Gender ratio mentioned as discrepant among groups but individual participant sexes not reported; animal experiments used male mice

zigosity.notes: Twin studies not mentioned in this paper.

age_min.notes: No age range information reported for human cohort.

age_max.notes: No age range information reported for human cohort.

age_years.notes: No specific age values reported for human participants.

antibiotics_current_use.evidence_quote: Individuals were also excluded if they had received antibiotics or probiotics within the last 8 weeks.
antibiotics_current_use.section: Methods — Study cohort and patient characteristics
antibiotics_current_use.notes: Exclusion criterion: no antibiotic use within 8 weeks prior to enrollment.

bmi.notes: BMI values not reported in text; only mentioned that no remarkable regularity of bacterial abundance based on BMI was found.

dietary_restriction.notes: No specific dietary restrictions reported for participants.

disease.evidence_quote: The cohort consisted of 41 healthy controls, 56 subjects with pHTN, and 99 patients with primary HTN.
disease.section: Results — GM diversity and enterotype in pHTN and HTN
disease.notes: Disease status used to define participant groups.

disease_details.section: Results — GM diversity and enterotype in pHTN and HTN
disease_details.notes: Only HTN group specified as 'primary hypertension'; pHTN and healthy controls not further specified.

disease_response_orr.notes: Study not evaluating treatment response or overall response rate.

disease_response_pfs.notes: Not applicable; study is observational microbiome analysis, not treatment trial.

disease_response_pfs_month.notes: Not applicable; study is observational microbiome analysis, not treatment trial.

disease_response_recist.notes: Not applicable; RECIST criteria are for solid tumors, not hypertension.

feces_phenotype.evidence_quote: Stool samples freshly collected from each participant were immediately frozen and bacterial DNA was extracted.
feces_phenotype.section: Methods — Stool sample collection and DNA extraction
feces_phenotype.notes: Study analyzed stool microbiome composition and diversity as main phenotypes.

fmt_id.notes: FMT donor IDs referenced in Table S17 but specific participant identifiers not provided in main text.

fmt_role.evidence_quote: fecal bacteria from hypertensive patients were transplanted to GF mice. Male GF mice at 8–10 weeks were divided into groups and orally inoculated with stool samples.
fmt_role.section: Results — High BP is transferrable by fecal transplant
fmt_role.notes: Study included human donors (hypertensive and normotensive controls) and recipient germ-free mice.

hla.notes: HLA typing not performed or reported in this study.

neonatal_birth_weight.notes: Study cohort consists of adult employees; neonatal data not applicable.

neonatal_delivery_procedure.notes: Study cohort consists of adult employees; neonatal data not applicable.

neonatal_feeding_method.notes: Study cohort consists of adult employees; neonatal data not applicable.

neonatal_gestational_age.notes: Study cohort consists of adult employees; neonatal data not applicable.

neonatal_preterm_birth.notes: Study cohort consists of adult employees; neonatal data not applicable.

obgyn_birth_control.notes: Birth control use not reported for study participants.

obgyn_lactating.notes: Lactation status not reported for study participants.

obgyn_menopause.notes: Menopausal status not reported; gender ratio mentioned as discrepant among groups but no specific information provided.

obgyn_pregnancy.notes: Study cohort consists of adult employees from Kailuan Group; pregnancy status not reported.

smoker.evidence_quote: Patients suffering from cancer, heart failure, renal failure, smoking, stroke, peripheral artery disease, and chronic inflammatory disease were all excluded.
smoker.section: Results — GM diversity and enterotype in pHTN and HTN
smoker.notes: Smoking was an exclusion criterion; all included participants are non-smokers.

treatment.evidence_quote: All the subjects in the hypertension group were newly diagnosed hypertensive patients prior to antihypertensive treatment.
treatment.section: Results — GM diversity and enterotype in pHTN and HTN
treatment.notes: No antihypertensive medications reported; specific excluded drugs listed (statins, aspirin, insulin, metformin, nifedipine, metoprolol) but current active treatments not detailed.

tumor_staging_ajcc.notes: Not applicable; study focuses on hypertension, not cancer.

tumor_staging_tnm.notes: Not applicable; study focuses on hypertension, not cancer.

biomarker_name.evidence_quote: Prevotella and Klebsiella overgrowth; reduced Faecalibacterium, Roseburia, Bifidobacterium; decreased diversity, phosphatidylserine, lysophosphatidylcholine levels
biomarker_name.notes: Multiple biomarkers identified across metagenomic and metabolomic analyses in control, pHTN, and HTN groups

biomarker_unit.evidence_quote: Relative abundance calculated; gene count compared; Shannon index assessed; metabolites measured by LC/MS
biomarker_unit.notes: Units vary depending on biomarker type; metabolite units inferred from LC/MS analysis methodology

value: Shannon index lower in pHTN and HTN (P=0.023 C vs P; P=0.016 C vs H)
gene count decreased (P=0.024 C vs P; P=0.04 C vs H)
biomarker_value.evidence_quote: Dramatically decreased microbial richness and diversity; Prevotella-dominated enterotype; P values <0.05 by Wilcoxon rank sum test
biomarker_value.notes: Values reported as comparative differences and statistical significance levels; classification AUC values indicate biomarker discriminatory power

disease_response_os.notes: Paper focuses on hypertension pathogenesis and blood pressure measurements, not overall survival

disease_response_os_unit.notes: Not applicable; no survival data reported

ecog_performance_status.notes: ECOG performance status not reported; study focused on microbiota and metabolic profiles in hypertension

feces_phenotype_value.evidence_quote: Prevotella-dominated gut enterotype; reduced gene richness and diversity; increased LPS biosynthesis modules in pHTN and HTN
feces_phenotype_value.section: Results — GM diversity and enterotype; pHTN and HTN-associated genera; Functional alteration
feces_phenotype_value.notes: Fecal microbiota phenotypes characterized through metagenomic sequencing; 196 samples analyzed from control, pHTN, and HTN groups

tumor_size_measurement.notes: Not applicable; study on hypertension and gut microbiota, not cancer

tumor_size_residual_measurement.notes: Not applicable; study on hypertension and gut microbiota, not cancer treatment

value: Cohort from Kailuan Group Corporation employees in Tangshan, northern China
All HTN subjects newly diagnosed, treatment-naive
Excluded: cancer, heart failure, renal failure, smoking, stroke, peripheral artery disease, chronic inflammatory disease
Excluded drugs: statins, aspirin, insulin, metformin, nifedipine, metoprolol
Excluded if antibiotics or probiotics within 8 weeks
Fecal microbiota transplantation into germ-free mice (n=5 control, n=10 HTN)
Blood pressure elevated in HTN mice post-transplantation (P < 0.05)
124 subjects underwent metabolomic analysis (30 control, 31 pHTN, 63 HTN)
1290 chromatographic peaks identified in ES+, 2289 variables in ES−
26 metabolites significantly altered in both pHTN and HTN vs control
uncurated_metadata.evidence_quote: Cohort of 41 healthy controls, 56 pHTN, 99 HTN; 1211 Gb 125-bp paired-end reads; transplanted into germ-free mice showing elevated BP
uncurated_metadata.notes: Study design, participant characteristics, and key experimental parameters documented

Multiple biomarkers reported across different analytical platforms (metagenomic sequencing, LC/MS metabolomics, 16S rRNA); units and measurement scales vary
Host species field refers to primary study population (Homo sapiens); however, fecal transplantation experiments used germ-free mice (Mus musculus) as recipient hosts
Blood pressure measurements in mice (tail-cuff method) reported at single time point (10 weeks post-transplantation); no longitudinal survival data reported
